high_level_description: This image captures a formal event set against the backdrop of the Eiffel Tower in Paris. The scene is likely from a promotional event or premiere, as indicated by the "DUNE" branding on the blue backdrop behind the two individuals. People: On the left, there is a person dressed in a black turtleneck sweater and shiny brown pants, paired with black dress shoes. On the right, there is another individual wearing a white, asymmetrical dress with cut-out details at the waist and a high slit on one side. They are also wearing white high-heeled shoes.
